segments.text: Gilgamesh is one of the four playable Servants available to the protagonist in Fate/Extra CCC.

He is an alternate version of his counterpart that appears in Fate/stay night. Unlike the counterpart who is summoned under the Archer class, he claims that he does not fall under any of the Servant classes, so he is referred to only as Gilgamesh.
Jinako Carigiri is the Master of Karna in the Holy Grail War of the Moon Cell in Fate/Extra CCC.
She summons Karna as a Lancer class during the Holy Grail War on the Near Side, however she changes his class name to Launcher due to Brahmastra appearing similar to a beam attack.
Karna is the Servant of Jinako Carigiri in the Moon Cell's Holy Grail War in Fate/Extra CCC.
Unlike his counterpart summoned under the Lancer class, he is referred to as Karna and designated by his Master as being of the Launcher Servant class.

Karna appears in the Indian epic poem The Mahabharata, as a hero on the vanquished side. The central conflict of The Mahabharata is the war over influence between the Pandava royal family and Kaurava royal family. Karna became famous as the rival of Arjuna, the great hero of Hindu mythology.
Lancer, known as Strange Tail Girl in the original promotional materials, is an enemy Servant in the Moon Cell Holy Grail War in Fate/Extra CCC.

She is unique in that she switches between four different Masters as a Lancer-class Servant, Rin Tohsaka, Rani VIII, Shinji Matou, and Hakuno Kishinami, and she later acts as the Berserker-class Servant of Meltlilith.
Her identity is Elizabeth Bathory. She is given the keyword "Dragon's Daughter," related to her nickname "Countess Dracula."
Elizabeth Bathory was originally summoned by Run Ru as a Lancer class Servant but after BB assassinated Run Ru, Lancer choose to willingly collaborate with BB.
Sesshouin Kiara is the Master of Caster in Fate/Extra CCC .
She's in fact the true antagonist.
Caster is the Caster-class Servant of Kiara Sessyoin in the Moon Cell Holy Grail War of Fate/Extra CCC.

Caster's identity is Hans Christian Andersen. A real person, born 1805 and died 1875 due to liver cancer. Now he is remembered as one of the Three Great Authors, but half his lifetime was full of frustration and agony.
The overseer of the Moon Holy Grail War. He is an NPC created by the Moon Cell.
BB is a character ressembling Sakura Matou in Fate/Extra CCC and is one of the antagonist in the game.

BB is a backup AI created by Sakura containing her feelings for Hakuno Kishinami. She is said to have created the Sakura Labyrinth, and later created both Meltlilith and Passionlip. who resemble her and Sakura.
Passionlip is a High Servant of BB in Fate/Extra CCC.

Passionlip was created by BB as a Heroic Spirit-Complex. Classified as a High-Servant who is composed of three goddesses, Parvati, Durga, and Brynhildr. Parvati is the goddess of beauty from India who is a blindingly trusting and devoted goddess who loved her husband, the God of Destruction Shiva. Durga is the goddess of war, considered to be a facet of Parvati. She possesses ten divine weapons, and Passionlip's gigantic nails are the incarnation of these ten blades.

Brynhild is the goddess of war from Northern Europe. She was queen who was not able to join hands with her beloved hero and invited ruin from her sadness. She is treated as Brunhilde in Wagner's musical, appearing as a Valkyrie, a battle maiden, who escorts the souls of the dead to the heavens. Her circumstances were also a tragedy in which she despaired from love and raised her hand against her loved one.
After consuming both Passionlip and Meltlilith, her appearance changes to a demon and through Caster's Noble Phantasm and the Moon Cell, she reaches a similar existence to a True Demon.
Meltlilith is a High-Servant of BB in Fate/Extra CCC.
Meltlilith was created by BB as a Heroic Spirit-Complex. Classified as a High-Servant who is composed of three goddesses, Artemis, Lotan, and Saraswati.

segments.text: Twice H. Pieceman was born in born in a place where a war being fought. He was a war orphan and was later adopted by his foster parents. He became a prominent scientist in the fields of advanced neurosurgery in the latter half of the 20th century and pioneered the science of digital hacking and he is thought to be the first Spritron-hacker. He discovered a cure for the disease known as Amnesia Syndrome. After becoming a scientist, he still risked his life to save others. When he was called to a city to treat victims of the disease he was killed in a bioterrorism attack. His data was recorded by the Moon Cell Automaton and became part of the system. After serving in multiple Grail Wars as an NPC, the constant exposure to the human Masters combining with his skill as a Spiritron-hacker eventually caused his data to become self-aware, and he now exists in the Moon Cell as both a NPC and a Master.

After becoming self-aware, Twice became a Master and summoned Caster. He went on to fight in countless Holy Grail Wars, but failed to win the war. Eventually he lost Caster and he prayed for salvation until he was given a new servant, Saver. Saver responded to Twice, not because he agreed with Twice's ideals, but out of compassion for his soul. However, once he reached the core of the Moon Cell, he found that, as an NPC, he could not enter the core without being deleted as invalid data. From there, he redesigned the Holy Grail War to the current system and asked each Master who was victorious in the Holy Grail War to wish for the perpetuation of war and the continued advancement of man. However, all the Masters who faced him refused, and thus were killed by him and Saver. He and Saver are the final bosses of the game.

Rin is a model student and idol of Shirou's school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students.

She is also secretly a magus and a Master in the Holy Grail War. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, Toosaka Tokiomi, to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from Kotomine Kirei.

She strives to earn the admiration of her peers to avoid drawing attention to her private life, even though she is secretly stingy, tomboyish, and a slacker. She is sharp, resourceful, and avidly competitive.
From Wikipedia
She also appears in Fate/Extra CCC as a hidden, optional boss. This is not to be confused with the Toosaka Rin in the same game.
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.
She is short in stature, but her arrogance more than makes up for it.
Her true identity is Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor. Her Noble Phantasm is called Aestus Domus Aurea (Theater of the Deranged) and resembles a Reality Marble.
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.
He is very similar to his Fate/stay night counterpart.
He does not possess a Noble Phantasm, but has a reality marble called Unlimited Blade Works.
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.
She is a beautiful fox woman with a cheerful disposition.
Her true identity is Tamamo-no-Mae, a soul that branched off from Amaterasu. Her Noble Phantasm is called Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi.
The nameable protagonist, who is the master of either Saber, Archer, or Caster.
The nameable protagonist, who is the master of either Saber, Archer, or Caster.
A participant in the Holy Grail War who is fighting against the Harways. She closely resembles her Fate/stay night counterpart.
She is a proficient hacker and her servant is one of the two Lancers (resembles the Lancer from Fate/stay night).
Early in Fate/Extra CCC, Rin joins the student council to help the remaining masters to escape from the Far side of the moon.
An Egyptian girl who is participating in the Holy Grail War. She is intelligent and polite, and her servant is Berserker.
She is actually a homunculus, created solely to take part in the war by her professor, Sialim Eltnam.
In Fate/Extra CCC, she serves as a member of the student council.
A participant in the Holy Grail War. He is a skilled hacker, and closely resembles his Fate/stay night counterpart in appearance. He is extremely arrogant, and his servant is Rider.
In reality, Shinji is actually an 8-year-old child.

segments.text: One of the participants in the Holy Grail War. He is the heir to the Harway family, which is in control of 60% of the real world. He is very polite, and wants to secure the Holy Grail because he believes it to be dangerous.
He is Julius Harway's younger brother, and his servant is the non-plable Saber Gawain.
In Fate/Extra CCC, he leads the student council in escaping from the Far side of the moon.
A participant in the Holy Grail War. She has the appearance of a doll, and her servant is the non-playable Caster.
She is already dead in the real world, and her spirit in the Moon Cell is a cyber ghost.

segments.text: A participant in the Holy Grail War.
He is a cold-hearted killer, and his role in the war is to ensure the victory of his younger brother, Leo.
His servant is Assassin.
A participant in the Holy Grail War. He is very incompetent, and worships his servant as a god.
His servant is one of the two Berserkers (resembles Arcueid from Tsukihime).
He is one of the members of the student council in Fate extra CCC.
One of the two Lancers that appear in the game; the servant of Toosaka Rin. He strongly resembles his Fate/stay night counterpart.
His true identity is Cú Chulainn, the great hero of Ireland. His Noble Phantasm is called Gae Bolg.
The servant of Leo Harway. He is a gallant knight, and unlike other servants, he reveals his name at the beginning of the story.
His true identity is Sir Gawain, the nephew of King Arthur and a Knight of the Round Table.
His Noble Phantasm is called Excalibur Galatine.
The servant of Dan Blackmore. He fights using ambushes, much to the chagrin of his morally strict master.
His true identity is Robin Hood. His Noble Phantasm is the Yew Bow.
The servant of Alice. Aside from the color of their clothing, they are identical in appearance. She cares for Alice a lot.
Her true identity is Nursery Rhyme, which isn't really considered a hero. She is based on Lewis Carroll's book, Alice in Wonderland, which was originally a nursery rhyme.
She herself is a Reality Marble, projecting the heart of her master and creating a pseudo-servant. Her Noble Phantasm is called The Queen's Glass Game.
An NPC in charge of the nurse's office. She resembles her Fate/stay night counterpart, but is not actually Shinji's sister - she is merely programmed to think so.
An NPC who provides quests to the protagonist. She resembles her Fate/stay night counterpart very closely.

A mysterious warrior of unspecified origins and era who serves as the Servant to Toosaka Rin. Exuding a palpable aura of cynicism and sarcasm, Archer's worldview starkly contrasts with that of Shirou's, whose idealistic and naive aspiration to 'save everyone' he perceives as an unattainable folly.

Archer is Emiya Shirou from a possible future, a magus specializing in psychometry and object replication with a focus on swords. Though his replicas may be weaker, he can enhance them to surpass even the originals. In addition, true to his talent since his youth, his unparalleled marksmanship complements his magical prowess, making him a formidable and versatile combatant.
Edited from Wikipedia
He also appears as an optional boss in Fate/Extra CCC. This is not to be confused with the playable Archer in that same game.
The eight Alter Egos of Caster (Tamamo-no-Mae). They desire to eliminate the original Tamamo and take Kishinami Hakuno for themselves.
